description: This file defines an abstract test class for verifying dependency injection (DI) integration with Orleans grains. It includes tests for constructor injection, singleton and scoped services, grain context access, and ensures that Orleans manages grain creation independently of DI container registrations. The class also configures services and tests various DI scenarios within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: DependencyInjectionGrainTestRunner
classes.description: Abstract base class providing a suite of dependency injection tests for Orleans grains, including service resolution, context access, and lifecycle verification.

classes.name: TestSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Nested class configuring DI services in the silo builder for testing, including singleton, scoped, and explicitly registered grains.

methods.name: CanGetGrainWithInjectedDependencies
methods.description: Tests that a grain can be instantiated with constructor-injected dependencies.

methods.name: CanGetGrainWithInjectedGrainFactory
methods.description: Verifies that IGrainFactory is accessible for grains via injection.

methods.name: CanResolveSingletonDependencies
methods.description: Checks that singleton services are shared across multiple grain activations.

methods.name: CanResolveScopedDependencies
methods.description: Confirms scoped services create distinct instances per grain activation.

methods.name: CanResolveScopedGrainActivationContext
methods.description: Ensures IGrainActivationContext is available per grain activation and contains correct GrainId.

methods.name: ScopedDependenciesAreThreadSafe
methods.description: Validates thread safety and consistent scoped service behavior under concurrent calls.

methods.name: CanResolveSameDependenciesViaServiceProvider
methods.description: Tests that services resolved via IServiceProvider match constructor-injected instances.

methods.name: CanResolveSingletonGrainFactory
methods.description: Ensures all grains get the same instance of IGrainFactory.

methods.name: CannotGetExplictlyRegisteredGrain
methods.description: Verifies that explicitly registered DI grains are not resolvable through Orleans activation system.

methods.name: CanUseGenericArgumentsInConstructor
methods.description: Tests dependency injection with generic grains based on type parameters.
